title: ayenia heterophylla
intro: Ayenia heterophylla, commonly known as the "Mexican Herb" or "Mexican Sage", is a shrubby perennial plant native to the tropical regions of Mexico and Central America. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and treat respiratory issues such as asthma and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Ayenia heterophylla include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ayenia heterophylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
